about.title: RefTest Management System
about.description: This application manages handball rules RefTests. Administrators can create RefTests for multiple users, send email invitations, track RefTest progress and completion status, filter and sort RefTests by various criteria, and view performance analytics including scores and completion rates. RefTests support {{count}} languages ({{languages}}).

creation.title: RefTest Creation
creation.description: Create RefTests for multiple users at once. Each RefTest is assigned to a specific user with unique tracking capabilities.

management.title: RefTest Management
management.description: Track RefTests through their lifecycle: pending, in progress, completed, or expired. Filter and sort by status, date, score, or user email. Send invitations and manage all RefTest actions.

data.title: Personal data we process
data.body: We process your name, email address, invitation token, assessment progress, answers, result, preferred language, and the dates on which you interact with the assessment. We also retain limited administrator and audit information needed to operate and secure the service.

purposes.title: Why we process it
purposes.body: We use this data to invite you, run and score the optional assessment, communicate its result, provide support, prevent misuse, and maintain an audit trail for the service.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: We use legitimate interests to process the contact information needed to send and manage an invitation. Participation in the assessment is optional and requires your explicit acceptance of this notice before it starts; you may withdraw that consent at any time.

recipients.title: Service providers
recipients.body: We use Auth0 for authentication, Brevo to deliver emails, and the IHF Rules Questions service to retrieve assessment content and calculate results. These providers process data only as needed to provide their services.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We erase assessment and invitation data three years after the assessment is completed or expires. If you withdraw consent after identity verification, we erase your assessment data and queued communications without delay. Email already delivered to your inbox cannot be recalled.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, or a portable copy of your data, and may withdraw consent. Contact kristof.gilis@outlook.be. You may also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.
